description: Conformance baseline of docs/CHANNEL_PROTOCOL.md: per adapter and case, pass, xfail (fails today: cause with file:line at anchorsAt, and whether the core or the adapter owns the fix) or n/a (the platform offers nothing to exercise). Strict: a case that starts passing fails the run until this file is updated.
anchorsAt: the commit that last changed this file (git log -1 -- tests/channels/conformance/baseline.json): every file:line in a cause is re-anchored whenever this file changes

cases.duplicate_delivery: At-least-once delivery: recorded and routed once.
cases.out_of_order: An older message reaching the core after a newer one is still recorded and routed.
cases.edit: An edit is recorded as a revision of the original event.
cases.recall: A recall marks the event recalled and removes its text.
cases.auth_expiry: A refused credential is auth_required with an owner remedy; the supervisor stops restarting.
cases.displaced_stays_down: Another login taking the session is displaced: no reconnect, across a restart, until restored.
cases.rate_limited: A rate-limited send is not attempted again inside the window, then goes out once.
cases.partial_history_failure: A failed history read keeps the connection and live delivery; the gap is replayed later.
cases.degraded_is_typed: A failed history read is reported as degraded/history_failed.
cases.runtime_fault_is_typed: The adapter runtime refusing is runtime_missing, not auth_required.
cases.network_fault_is_typed: A network failure is disconnected with a network or transport code.
cases.restart_mid_send: After a crash between platform acceptance and receipt, no second copy.
cases.reconciliation_read_failure: A failed reconciliation read is no evidence of absence: the item stays unknown, nothing is re-sent, the next complete read settles it once.
cases.stalled_thread_isolation: An unknown item whose reconciliation read keeps failing holds only its own thread; another thread's item goes out in the same pass.
cases.accepted_confirmation: A file the platform accepted is never left waiting silently: once the next pass cannot confirm it, it is held as history_failed or needs_owner_confirmation with one outbox fault, never sent again, holding no other thread, and settled by the first read that shows it.
cases.unknown_keeps_its_identity: A bot send whose answer was lost is reconciled under the bot, never repeated as the owner.
cases.unknown_reconciliation: A delivered send whose answer was lost is reconciled, never re-sent blindly.
cases.attachment_degradation: A file the platform cannot carry is degraded to a note, never refused or dropped.
cases.echo_loop: Our own send coming back is never input.
cases.other_bots: Another bot's message is never a command or a review candidate.
cases.self_send_outside_outbox: A message this account sent through another Tofu path (Tofu's marker, no outbox item), live or replayed by backfill, is never owner input.

edit.reason: 大象 has no message edits (no edit API or event in dx-engine)

recall.cause: the adapter drops a recalled message (`lib/channels/dx/adapter.py:431` live, `lib/channels/dx/adapter.py:459` history: isCancel returns None) instead of reporting a recall event, so the recorded text stays; the core records recalls (`lib/channels/store.py:288`)

rate_limited.reason: 大象 documents no rate limit for the owner's own session; the robot's shared 5/s limit falls back to the owner at once (C6, test_dx_robot_shared.py)

degraded_is_typed.cause: a failed catch-up is reported as connected with free-text detail (`lib/channels/dx/adapter.py:959`), invisible to the Watchdog

attachment_degradation.reason: 大象 carries the files natively (x-dxAttachments)

out_of_order.cause: a comment visible after its window is never read: each list resumes at the newest updated_at it saw (`lib/channels/github/adapter.py:382`, `lib/channels/github/adapter.py:364`; C8 Limits)

edit.cause: an edited comment keeps its event ID (`lib/channels/github/normalize.py:123`, from created_at) and reaches the core as a new message, which ingress drops as a duplicate (`lib/channels/ingress.py:158`); the core records edit events as revisions (`lib/channels/store.py:288`), so the adapter must report one

recall.reason: GitHub REST lists show no deletions, and C8 reads no events API

displaced_stays_down.reason: the platform documents no event for another login taking the session

partial_history_failure.cause: one failed list read ends the whole session (`lib/channels/github/adapter.py:202`), so no thread progresses until the next tick

degraded_is_typed.cause: a failed list read is reported as disconnected (`lib/channels/github/adapter.py:202`), not degraded

runtime_fault_is_typed.reason: the adapter has no runtime of its own beside the server

accepted_confirmation.reason: the platform carries no files natively: a file becomes a note in the text (attachment_degradation)

other_bots.cause: the adapter drops GitHub's user type Bot (`lib/channels/github/normalize.py:83`), so the comment reaches the core with sender kind user and is a candidate in watch threads; the core keeps a bot's message to context (`lib/channels/policy.py:87`)

self_send_outside_outbox.cause: the marker pattern accepts only outbox item IDs (`lib/channels/github/normalize.py:28`), so a comment carrying another Tofu marker reaches the core without it and the owner's comment in a watched thread becomes a candidate (`lib/channels/policy.py:100`); the core treats any other marker value as an echo (x-selfEcho origin_marker)
